adversarial_probes.method: 4 probes (PROBE-A×2, PROBE-B×3, PROBE-C, PROBE-D×2 = 8 test cases) in ephemeral _probe_t0067_adversarial.test.ts; all 8 PASS; file DELETED after run, working tree clean.
adversarial_probes.PROBE_A_enqueue_throw_behavior: CONFIRMED: when enqueue() throws (simulated Postgres transient error), runBridgeOnce propagates the exception. The poll-loop (startBridgePollLoop) swallows it via .catch() per ADR §4.4 / AC-14. External task stays locked in Flowable until lockDurationMs. On re-poll (simulating Flowable lock timeout), same externalTask.id → idempotency_key conflict → returns existing job; no duplicate. Idempotency guarantee holds.
adversarial_probes.PROBE_A_finding: Note: bridge does NOT continue within the batch after an enqueue exception (no per-task try/catch for enqueue errors — only for fetchAndLock errors). Spec FR-3 'продолжает следующий task' applies specifically to assertVariableValue guard rejection, not enqueue infrastructure failure. Behavior is consistent with poll-loop swallowing: next interval retries the task (Flowable re-offers after lock timeout). NOT classified as product defect — within spec scope.
adversarial_probes.PROBE_B_nested_guard: CONFIRMED: assertVariableValue recurses into nested plain objects. PROBE-B1: outer object with key 'data' → isRawObjectWithData → rejected immediately (raw_object_with_data). PROBE-B2: { wrapper: { rec: { kind:'record', registryId, recordId } } } → outer recurses into wrapper value → inner recurses into rec → isRecordRef → rejected (record_payload). Guard catches at 2nd nesting level. PROBE-B3: bridge skips task with deep nested record-ref via 'wrapper' key; other tasks in batch proceed. Guard depth is correct per T-0028 assertVariableValue spec.
adversarial_probes.PROBE_C_parallel_idempotency: CONFIRMED: two concurrent runBridgeOnce with identical fetchResults (same 2 externalTask.ids) → 4 total fetches, but exactly 2 unique jobs (MockJobStore idempotency_key dedup). No race condition in the idempotency logic.
adversarial_probes.PROBE_D_retries_mapping: CONFIRMED: deliver(task_failed) passes retries value from outbox payload directly to Flowable failTask. retries=2 → failTask called with retries=2 (no extra decrement — decrement already happened in JobStore at fail() time). retries=0 → failTask called with retries=0 (terminal). Flowable receives the correct retry count.
